candidate.scope: All tracked and non-ignored new files at the first closing, exported with repository-relative paths. Later documentation and receipt changes are covered by editorial_delta below.

limits: Secret scanning is not proof that every possible secret is absent. Demo credentials are intentionally synthetic, documented and local; no new exceptions were added.

editorial_delta.scope: Only the final documentation/receipt delta exported with repository-relative paths and the unchanged scanner config. No new history or full candidate scan. Failure prevents handoff.
